beats.narrative_purpose: Show real moving footage first without clutter so the viewer feels rhythm immediately.

audio_intent.strategy: Real city waterfront ambience layered over soft apartment room-tone bedrock.

beats.visual_subject: Rainy city street at night with pedestrian umbrella (veo_rain.mp4 0.6-1.8s)
beats.broll_justification: Advances visual momentum cleanly onto the beat while introducing natural falling rain texture.
beats.narrative_purpose: Cut on the 1.20s bar beat from harbor air into wet nocturnal rain motion.

audio_intent.strategy: Genuine rain clip audio J-cut 80ms early with soft air carry into rain.

beats.visual_subject: Close-up hands typing rapidly on warm desk laptop (veo_hands.mp4 0.5-1.7s)
beats.broll_justification: Completes the three-shot opening sequence with close mechanical motion.
beats.narrative_purpose: Anchor close mechanical keystrokes directly onto fingers moving across keys.

audio_intent.strategy: Real desk ambience plus tactile CC0 keystrokes locked directly to finger taps.

beats.visual_subject: Speaker in living room explaining footage awareness (veo_pause_en.mp4 jump-cut tightened)
beats.narrative_purpose: State the thesis directly in human voice once the viewer has watched three honest shots.
beats.on_screen_copy: The first thing that matters is looking closely at your footage.

audio_intent.strategy: Natural actor voice centered with adaptive 9-band carving on the entering warm underscore.

beats.visual_subject: Green calibrated cutting mat (#1B3B2B) with three craft-paper clip strips (CLIP 1, CLIP 2, CLIP 3) sliced cleanly on beat marks
beats.narrative_purpose: Break down why the opening sequence felt tight using physical craft cards instead of glowing shapes.
beats.on_screen_copy: Three matching shots. Cut to rhythm.

audio_intent.strategy: Physical craft-paper flips and crisp slice clicks matched as each card lands on the cutting mat.

beats.visual_subject: Warm craft paper card (#F4EFE6) prompting the silent A/B comparison
beats.narrative_purpose: Set up the A/B comparison explicitly before stripping the sound away.

audio_intent.strategy: Clean soft wood tap marking card arrival right before the silence pocket engages.

beats.visual_subject: Replay of city, rain, and hands clips muted inside an AUDIO OFF frame marker
beats.narrative_purpose: Prove visually and acoustically how flat identical footage feels without motivated foley.

audio_intent.strategy: Intentional -52 dB music silence pocket keeping only hushed ambient room floor.

beats.visual_subject: Warm craft paper cue card introducing literal cause-and-effect audio
beats.narrative_purpose: State the zero-waste rule plainly before bringing real foley back in.
beats.on_screen_copy: Add only what moves on screen.

audio_intent.strategy: Reversed musical swell leading gently out of silence pocket into tactile paper card.

beats.visual_subject: City dusk bay footage (real_city.mp4) with live green Harbor wind stereo waveform pill
beats.narrative_purpose: Show the waveform pill popping up ONLY while harbor ambience fills the shot.

audio_intent.strategy: Real harbor clip wind texture foregrounded cleanly alongside green stereo waveform bar display.

beats.visual_subject: Rainy crosswalk footage (veo_rain.mp4) with live Street rain stereo waveform pill
beats.broll_justification: Shows how literal rain audio replaces arbitrary swooshes on cut arrival.
beats.narrative_purpose: Pair wet crosswalk visuals directly with real falling rainfall and J-cut cloth pass.

audio_intent.strategy: Real rain audio boosted cleanly in mid-high detail synced to live rain waveform pill.

beats.visual_subject: Desk hands typing (veo_hands.mp4) with live Laptop keys stereo waveform pill
beats.broll_justification: Closes the three-example proof showing crisp mechanical sound anchored to keys.
beats.narrative_purpose: Match physical keystrokes strictly to finger motion while displaying real foley waveform.

audio_intent.strategy: Clean key presses and desk presence matching live waveform pill peaks.

beats.visual_subject: Typing workspace footage overlaid with genuine NLE music waveform strip and pointer arrow on volume dip
beats.narrative_purpose: Reveal visibly how music dips softly into the final coastal transition instead of slamming into silence.

audio_intent.strategy: Music bed enters a controlled gain dip feeding a Great Hall T60=2.6s tail into coastal bay.

beats.visual_subject: Calm coastal harbor at dusk (real_sea.mp4 1.0-3.4s) with restrained ivory title closing
beats.narrative_purpose: End gently on real horizon motion and natural ocean room wash with zero noise clutter.

audio_intent.strategy: Great Hall tail blooms gently over real harbor waves before clean 12ms fade out.

silence_pockets.reason: Silent half of A/B demonstration (AUDIO: OFF) letting viewer hear bare quiet room tone.

sound_cues.visual_cause: Camera cuts across harbor sky into pouring night street with umbrella pedestrian.
Fingers strike laptop keyboard keys at 2.42s, 2.74s, 3.08s.
Three physical craft-paper clip strips slide onto the green cutting mat and slice sequentially.
Cream instruction paper card flips into frame announcing the silent A/B cut.
Rain waveform badge pops at bottom edge as umbrella pedestrian walks through downpour.
Hands tap keys right as Laptop keys waveform badge rises on screen.
NLE volume dip arrow points to fade into calm coastal bay horizon.
